secondary_qualifier: Scoped no-go for scalar reverse-face and adjoint completion
exact_theorem: For the declared plaquette word P, reversal gives log(P^{-1})=-log(P).  The oriented Palatini face bivector changes sign at the same time, hence the legal reversed-face contribution equals the original contribution.  Every scalar forward/reverse completion is therefore lambda times the original real-space Palatini quadratic form.  Nonzero lambda preserves its Fourier rank profile, while lambda=0 gives the zero form.

rank_consequence.required_for_pass: rank 64 on all 24 nonzero null-sheet sectors

meaning: The canonical orientation double cover and reverse-edge inversion cannot repair the two-versus-one extra-corank imbalance by merely adding the reversed or adjoint scalar Palatini face.  Treating the reverse edge as an independent new degree of freedom would contradict the declared groupoid inverse rule.

counter_intuition.tempting_reading: The missing propagation direction may be restored simply by adding the reverse-oriented face.
counter_intuition.ordinary_explanation: An oriented integral already contains the orientation sign; reversing both the integrand two-form and the oriented face leaves the scalar action unchanged.
counter_intuition.strongest_boundary: A source-derived off-diagonal coupling between two internal chiral or dagger-conjugate sheet representations would not be a scalar reverse-face completion and is not excluded here.
counter_intuition.falsifier: A source-authorized reverse contribution not proportional to the original real-space quadratic form and yielding exact rank 64 on both null sheets.

bold_hypothesis_required_after_two_no_go.interpretive_leap: The source orientation double cover acts on two dagger-conjugate internal bivector representations rather than duplicating one scalar Palatini face.
bold_hypothesis_required_after_two_no_go.new_structure: A real dagger-completed self-dual/anti-self-dual or equivalent off-diagonal doubled-branch Hessian with equal weights fixed by the involution.
bold_hypothesis_required_after_two_no_go.strongest_ordinary_alternative: The current real GL4 Palatini block already contains both internal bivector chiralities, so the proposed double cover either duplicates the same Hessian or introduces an unsupported new axiom.
bold_hypothesis_required_after_two_no_go.counter_intuition_scan: Parity restoration is standard lattice regulator repair and may not be Braid-specific.  Any successful term must be derived before its rank is inspected and must fail under a matched non-Braid orientation/dagger control.
bold_hypothesis_required_after_two_no_go.exact_falsifier: The source involution does not define two inequivalent internal bivector sheets, the dagger-completed symbol remains proportional to the old symbol, or either null sheet fails exact additional corank two.
bold_hypothesis_required_after_two_no_go.minimum_decisive_test: Derive the sheet involution and its quadratic form algebraically, then compute the exact Q(zeta_5,i) rank profile on the 45 symmetry orbits without fitting.
bold_hypothesis_required_after_two_no_go.claim_ceiling: At most a scoped finite-parent completion; no global continuation, Braid necessity or empirical claim.

claim_ceiling: BQGSTRAT-011 excludes only scalar reverse-face, reverse-edge and adjoint completions generated by the already-declared orientation operations.  It does not exclude a newly derived off-diagonal doubled-branch representation, quasi-local perfect action, matter-coupled parent, generic singular continuation, Braid necessity, empirical gravity, confirmation, RPD adoption, Level 3 or Official SIEL adoption.
